rationale.edition: All 25 changed paths live under web/src/** (Vue frontend) and scripts/translations/** (i18n state), with the rest being locale JSON files. No enterprise/, o2_enterprise/, or src/enterprise/ paths are touched and there are no enterprise-owned modules, so this is an OSS change. The code references config.isEnterprise only to support an enterprise Slack-URL override, which is an OSS-frontend concern, not an enterprise-owned path.
rationale.skip: Not skipped. The change adds a brand-new user-facing popup (ConnectDataSourcePopup) mounted in MainLayout and rewires the CommunitySlackInvite flow into a day-2 follow-up, which is user-exercisable UI behavior. No tests-added label and no skip comment were passed, and the trigger/feature inputs are empty.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted: a new 'connect your first data source' onboarding dialog (Cloud-gated, with a connect button, Slack link, and org-summary gating) plus a changed standalone Slack-invite popup and their anti-stacking coordination are all user-visible flows that need UI verification.
rationale.area: GeneralTests: the feature is a cross-cutting onboarding/marketing popup hosted in MainLayout rather than a Logs/Metrics/Traces/Dashboards/etc. feature. The GeneralTests folder already holds comparable global UI specs (sanity, landingPage, languageTranslation, theme-management).
rationale.group: GeneralTests: the closest existing ci_matrix shard for global, non-product-area UI flows. The Engineer should append connectDataSourcePopup.spec.js to that group's run_files.
rationale.existing_tests: No E2E specs in the diff. The only test files changed are Vitest unit specs under web/src/** (CommunitySlackInvite.spec.ts, ConnectDataSourcePopup.spec.ts, onboardingPopupCoordination.spec.ts, slackCommunityInvite.spec.ts), none of which are Playwright E2E coverage.
